notes.title: 🎮 Dhadoom! Update – Smoother Moves & Bug Fixes 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey Dhadoomers!
We just pushed a small but meaningful update to make your chaotic races a bit smoother and more responsive.

[b] What’s New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved animation speed for climbing, vaulting, and recovering – everything feels snappier now!
[*]Minor polish to character motion makes the game feel tighter and more fluid in the heat of competition.
[/list]

[list]

Stay chaotic,
— Team Dhadoom! 💥

notes.title: Dhadoom! Update: Smooth Moves & Bug Busting
notes.content:
Hey Dhadoomers!

We’ve just rolled out a fresh update with some subtle but important improvements to make your parkour antics feel even smoother. Our animation team has fine-tuned a few character movements to enhance fluidity and responsiveness — you might not notice it at first glance, but trust us, it’s there!

Alongside these tweaks, we’ve squashed some minor bugs reported by the community to ensure your obstacle-racing chaos stays glitch-free and fun.

Keep dashing, vaulting, and swinging — and as always, thanks for playing Dhadoom!

Stay tuned for more updates and see you in the next race!

— The Dhadoom! Team

notes.title: 🛠️ Dhadoom! Hotfix – Ladder Climbing Bug Resolved

notes.title: 🔧 Dhadoom Update: Smoother Moves, Faster Fun!

notes.title: Dhadoom! Patch 1.0.3 – Desert Pathfinding Detox
notes.content:
Hey Champions of Chaos!

This week, we took a broom to the sand dunes and helped our AI friends find their way out of the heat. Here’s what’s new in this sun-scorched update:

🧠 AI Fixes
🐫 AI Lost in the Desert? Not Anymore!
Previously, our AI contestants were… let’s say spiritually wandering through the desert level. They’ve now remembered how to use their legs and are back to running, jumping, and flailing just like the rest of you.

🏜 Miscellaneous
🌬 Minor tweaks to sand particle effects to improve performance on lower-end devices.

☀ Adjusted lighting in desert areas to boost visibility (and look extra spicy in screenshots).

Thanks for continuing to break, bounce, and bellyflop your way through Dhadoom! More mayhem on the horizon — stay tuned!

– Team Dhadoom 🐪💥

notes.title: 🚢 Dhadoom! Patch 1.0.2 – All Aboard + New Faces!
notes.content:
Hey Dhadoomers!
We’ve patched up the decks and rolled out the red carpet for some fabulous new arrivals. Here's what's new in this update:

⚓ Ship Level Boarding Bug Fixed
Some players couldn’t mount the ship properly (tragic for a game about climbing things!). That’s now fixed — get ready to vault, cling, and chaotically board like never before.

💃 Meet Sophia and Tina!
Two brand new, drop-dead-gorgeous characters have joined the chaos. From high kicks to high dives, Sophia and Tina bring style, sass, and plenty of slapstick energy to the arena.

More updates are sailing your way soon, including new maps, wackier physics, and more characters with way too much confidence.

Thanks for playing, and keep the feedback (and blooper reels) coming!

– Team Dhadoom 🚀

notes.title: Dhadoom! – Patch 1.0.1: First Fixes & Player Feedback
notes.content:
Hey Challengers!

Thank you all for jumping, swinging, slipping, and faceplanting your way through Dhadoom! We’re thrilled with the early response and have already started squashing bugs and improving the game based on your feedback.

🔧 Bug Fixes
🐞 Fixed a rare bug where players would get stuck inside the Trampoline Sweeper (they really stuck the landing… permanently).

🐛 Resolved an issue with the lockpicking minigame not responding to inputs after respawn.

❄️ Snow shader no longer flickers when camera zooms out too far.

📦 Players can no longer phase through pushable crates during lag spikes.

🔄 Fixed camera desync when using wall-hug mechanic near corners.

🎵 Audio ducking was overly aggressive — now the background music doesn’t vanish when sound effects play.
